verdict.rationale: Checkout.com's own docs claim multi-currency fund storage with real-time visibility, which partly covers the real-time account-balance element of the story. Nothing in the pack covers a transaction ledger linking authorizations to clearing, settlement reporting, or reconciliation. missing for 10: real-time card balances, an authorization-to-clearing transaction ledger, settlement reporting, penny-level reconciliation, in-depth docs and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance lead, I can see money move in real time — account and card balances, a transaction ledger that ties every authorization to its clearing, and settlement reporting that reconciles to the penny

citations.quote: Store and manage funds in multiple currencies, with real-time visibility to meet your operational needs.
